title: Marry Me Chicken with Penne and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
description: A flavorful chicken dish served over penne pasta with sun-dried tomatoes and a creamy Parmesan sauce.

ingredients.item: about half a stick of butter

steps: Brown the chicken on both sides until over 165°F internal temperature, getting a golden brown color.
Pour in chicken stock and scrape up the flavor bits from the bottom of the pan.
Bring to a light boil, then lower heat.
Add heavy cream and Parmesan cheese, stirring until melted and combined.
Chop the sun-dried tomatoes and add to the sauce.
Cook the penne pasta separately until al dente.
Combine the cooked pasta with the sauce and chicken.
Garnish with parsley and serve with fresh broccoli.
notes:
Use fresh parsley for garnish and adjust seasoning to taste.
